answer_1.quote: Our system also brings more possibilities for an automation pipeline, solving how-to questions more efficiently... The body contains detailed information... fed into the LLM-based generator to generate answers.

answer_2.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that THREAD significantly outperforms... improving Ele. Acc by up to 9.61%, Op. F1 by up to 8.43%, and Step SR by up to 8.51%.

answer_3.quote: For the WikiHow dataset... we leverage LLMs to extract 'Action Items'... and use LLMs to evaluate (Appendix B.3 shows the evaluation prompt).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with twenty on-call engineers (OCEs)... Each OCE mitigates five incidents... We collect... HI: the steps requiring human intervention.
